title: Tower Buyer (Gnome Code)
script:
-- Tower Buy UI: Type a tower name and buy it if you have enough stars
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function findRemote(name)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("RemoteFunction") or descendant:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			if descendant.Name == name then
				return descendant
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local towers = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("TowerShop"))
local getDataFunc = findRemote("GetData")
local interactItemFunc = findRemote("InteractItem")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ===== Build the UI =====

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "TowerBuyGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Main small frame (top-right corner)
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name = "Main"
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 120)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -260, 0, 20)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = frame

-- Title
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Name = "Title"
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 8)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 14
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Text = "Buy Tower"
title.Parent = frame

-- Stars display
local starsLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
starsLabel.Name = "Stars"
starsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 18)
starsLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 32)
starsLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
starsLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
starsLabel.TextSize = 13
starsLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
starsLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
starsLabel.Text = "Stars: Loading..."
starsLabel.Parent = frame

-- TextBox for tower name
local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
textBox.Name = "TowerInput"
textBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28)
textBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 54)
textBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 55)
textBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
textBox.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
textBox.TextSize = 13
textBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
textBox.PlaceholderText = "Enter tower name..."
textBox.Text = ""
textBox.Parent = frame

local textBoxCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
textBoxCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
textBoxCorner.Parent = textBox

-- Buy button
local buyButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
buyButton.Name = "Buy"
buyButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28)
buyButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 88)
buyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 60)
buyButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
buyButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
buyButton.TextSize = 13
buyButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
buyButton.Text = "Buy"
buyButton.Parent = frame

local buyCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
buyCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
buyCorner.Parent = buyButton

-- Status / feedback label
local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Name = "Status"
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -20)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
statusLabel.TextSize = 11
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
statusLabel.Text = ""
statusLabel.Parent = frame

-- Toggle button (minimize/maximize)
local toggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleButton.Name = "Toggle"
toggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 24)
toggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 20)
toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 200)
toggleButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggleButton.TextSize = 12
toggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggleButton.Text = "Tower Shop"
toggleButton.Visible = false
toggleButton.Parent = screenGui

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggleButton

-- ===== Logic =====

local function refreshStars()
	if not getDataFunc then return nil end
	local data = getDataFunc:InvokeServer()
	if data then
		starsLabel.Text = "Stars: \226\152\133" .. tostring(data.Stars)
		return data
	end
	return nil
end

local function setStatus(text, color)
	statusLabel.Text = text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
end

local function buyTower()
	if not interactItemFunc then
		setStatus("InteractItem remote not found!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
		return
	end
	local towerName = textBox.Text
	if towerName == "" then
		setStatus("Please enter a tower name.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
		return
	end

	-- Check if the tower exists in the shop
	local towerData = towers[towerName]
	if not towerData then
		setStatus("Tower '" .. towerName .. "' not found.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
		return
	end

	-- Get player data to check stars
	if not getDataFunc then
		setStatus("GetData remote not found!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
		return
	end
	local playerData = getDataFunc:InvokeServer()
	if not playerData then
		setStatus("Could not fetch player data.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
		return
	end

	-- Check if already owned
	if table.find(playerData.OwnedTowers, towerName) then
		setStatus("You already own this tower.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0))
		return
	end

	-- Attempt purchase via InteractItem (stars check skipped)
	local result = interactItemFunc:InvokeServer(towerName)
	if result then
		starsLabel.Text = "Stars: \226\152\133" .. tostring(result.Stars)
		setStatus("Successfully bought " .. towerName .. "!", Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100))
		textBox.Text = ""
	else
		setStatus("Purchase failed.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
	end
end

-- Wire up events
buyButton.Activated:Connect(buyTower)

toggleButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	frame.Visible = true
	toggleButton.Visible = false
	refreshStars()
end)

-- Initialize
refreshStars()

print("TowerBuyGui loaded successfully")sfully")
features:
You Can Buy Towers from the TowerShop (work on tower defense games that use gnome code ONLY) if the game allows you can buy hidden towers in the shop that are 0 price or idk

How I Know if a Game uses Gnome Code kit?:

Load up Infinite Yeld and Put "Dex" its a recriation of Roblox Studio's Explorer (you cant see SSS and SS (ServerScriptService and ServerStorage) look in the Replicated Storage and try to Find something like "TowerShop" or "GetData" and "InteractItem" if theres these 3 in the Game it supports the Script (if the game has a different currency the star count might bug) the star count says how much currency you have.
